rules.rationale: Keyboard users must be able to identify the currently focused control.

rules.source: AIMETON Interface Audit v0.1: narrow viewport contract
rules.rationale: Primary actions and content must remain usable on a 320 px viewport without hidden mandatory controls.
Labels and actions should explain the user outcome instead of exposing implementation terminology.
A long-running operation must show current phase, heartbeat and a truthful terminal or blocked state.
